statement: Warren 2026-10-16 (corrects D-0105's 'restart'): the stock chain BRIDGES missing on-hand weeks. When on-hand is missing for some weeks but sales are reported for them, the next reported on-hand is compared with last reported on-hand + matched deliveries - all sales in between. The chain starts fresh only when sales are ALSO missing for the weeks in between (status 'unreported weeks', a data gap). Weeks with no on-hand are not compared themselves.
